summary: Show the splash in Debug and let a click skip it after 1 s
author: pm
body:
`sources/client/game.cpp` always starts on `Screen_Splash`; `screen_splash.cpp` skips to loading on a left-click press once 1 s has elapsed (all builds).

**Done when:** splash shows in Debug and skips on click after 1 s; reviewed, built Debug 0 errors.

Source: user request 2026-11-23, commit 9cfd510.
